title: National Theatre of Greece
axis: Local +X follows the mapped Agiou Konstantinou facade. Local +Z points toward the street.

nativeAxes.z: from rear towards Agiou Konstantinou Street

features.role: Mapped Ziller Building serving as the National Theatre's main stage.

identityStatus: The named native theatre outline establishes the map placement. The theatre operator identifies the Ziller Building and the original Qualla photograph establishes the principal facade.

terrainContact.basis: Original sampled sidewalk grade along Agiou Konstantinou Street, ahead of the facade.

notes: Two principal exterior storeys. The street view shows a blue-gray rusticated lower level, pale upper wall and cornice, central arched colonnade, triangulated side window pediments and a partially open attic parapet.
